Strike Engine Docs

How it works.

Strike Engine is a Solana token connected to a protocol-owned options treasury. The mechanism puts all fees received from trading on Meteora into call spreads with 1-day, 3-day, or 7-day expiries on BTC, SOL, HYPE and ZEC through Paradex, then directs all net realized trading profits to Strike Engine buybacks.

THE MECHANISM

From fees to buybacks.

01

Launch and trade on Meteora

Strike Engine launches on Solana through Meteora. A share of the trading fees received by the protocol is collected by the treasury.

02

Build the treasury

All fees received by the protocol remain protocol-owned and are allocated to the next trading cycle, using 1-day, 3-day, or 7-day expiries.

03

Open four call spreads

The treasury uses Paradex to open call spreads with 1-day, 3-day, or 7-day expiries across BTC, SOL, HYPE and ZEC. Each spread uses the same expiry for both option legs.

04

Buy back Strike Engine

All net realized trading profits are allocated to buy Strike Engine from the open market. Buybacks occur only when the treasury realizes a net trading profit.

THE STRATEGY

Defined-risk trades. Three expiry windows.

For each market, the treasury buys a call at a lower strike and sells a call at a higher strike. Both calls share the same expiry: 1 day, 3 days, or 7 days, depending on the selected spread. The sold call lowers the cost of the position, while the bought call covers it. That creates a defined maximum loss and a capped maximum profit.

BTC SOL HYPE ZEC
BELOW THE LOWER STRIKE

Maximum loss

The spread can expire worthless. The maximum loss is the net premium paid.

BETWEEN THE STRIKES

Value rises

The spread gains value as the market moves above the lower strike.

ABOVE THE UPPER STRIKE

Maximum profit

The upside is capped once the market reaches the higher strike.

All collected fees are put at risk in this strategy. If every spread expires worthless, the fees allocated to that cycle can be lost. Buybacks happen only from net realized trading profits.

TREASURY POLICY

Owned by the protocol.

Profit goes to buybacks

Net realized trading profits are allocated to protocol-directed Strike Engine buybacks, not paid out to individual holders.

No promised return

Holding Strike Engine does not create ownership of treasury assets or a promise of income, distributions or returns.

Trading has risk

The strategy has defined risk, but it can still lose the entire net premium paid. A buyback is not guaranteed and does not guarantee any market outcome.

Strike Engine stays on Solana

Strike Engine remains a Solana token. The treasury uses Paradex only for its options positions.

PLATFORMS

Built with existing markets.

Meteora provides Strike Engine’s Solana launch and trading market. Paradex provides the options venue used by the protocol treasury. Strike Engine is independent from and not affiliated with either platform.
